object.content: Here's the first version of the Backwoods Logger case. I really messed up the position of the buttons. I was experimenting with a M3 bolt used as a feedthrough with a spring to press the buttons. I have some longer pushbuttons, but they would be the same height as the top of the case. I have an idea for some 3D-printed button extenders, but last time I tried something similar it didn't work very well. Of course that was when I was very new to 3D-printing so I might have the knowledge to get it working now. I need to go to the hardware store tomorrow to get more M3 bolts so I can work on attaching the lid. The ones I have now are too short.
